issues.on_page: NONOPERATING REVENUES: Capital fund grants 23,030; Loss on sale of capital assets (2,172); Interest income 2,951; Total nonoperating revenues 23,809
issues.issue: Capital fund grants are printed as a nonoperating revenue inside the printed total 23,809, not as a 'Capital contributions' line below income before contributions (the case the housing-authority rule sends to other_financing). The extractor moved them and the loss on sale to other_financing, so reported_totals.business-type.receipts (169,467, computed) does not match the printed operating + nonoperating total (166,516 + 23,809 = 190,325). This is defensible, but a stricter reading records capital fund grants 23,030 as receipts (federal grants) and the loss (2,172) as sale of assets. The roll-forward holds either way.
